booklet_title.description: Game title printed on the intact instruction booklet.

likely_cartridge_title.description: Likely game title of the washed cartridge. You may infer it from the accompanying case/booklet and surviving label; this is a contextual identification, not verification of the cartridge contents.

cartridge_product_code.description: Complete original printed product code on the cartridge itself. Use only visible characters; do not supply a code from the booklet, memory or lookup.
